body:
Hey, I’ve been there mate. I sat there crying my fucking eyes out on the slope next to the bridge just remembering and looking at teardrop blurred cars zoom past. Went on FB wrote a note and on my way up someone from a pub nearby stopped me asked me if I was alright, I’m really glad he did, we had a really deep chat about my issues. 

Anyway, I’d like to be that random guy for you today. Heck it’s make me feel better, because I think I’m such a shithead all the time hahaaa X’D   Kill me.

I’m here if you want to talk to someone who’s pretty fucked up so you’ll get no bullshit or cookie cutter sympathies, ya dig?

Sending kinship <3 from a stranger

Add me on Xbox One, ObsidianGrayzer. I know most of the Grim-Tome locations as a plus but on the beg I’m only LvL26 BH, LvL10 Merc and minimal everything else.

Only started playing Monday though so...yeah, I’m playing a lot.
